scope.purpose: G1 internal 38-layer serial dispatch contract and frozen-manifest consistency validation

source_bindings.path: docs/obsidian-project/04-提交材料/阶段验收/S2A-T01_模型交付规格与G0接口冻结.md

network_dispatch.order: strict ascending layer_index; cfg_section equals layer_index+1
network_dispatch.input_reference_rule: network_input is a tagged external sentinel; integer references resolve only to earlier non-YOLO layer outputs; route input order is preserved verbatim

feature_workspace.address_space: G0 logical simulation byte address; not Zynq DDR physical address
feature_workspace.legal_overlap_rule: only YOLO layer 30->conv 29 and YOLO layer 37->conv 36 aliases; all owned feature output ranges are disjoint

layers.manifest_input_scale_semantics: single-source tensor scale, checked against the resolved input tensor

bias_source.semantics: 累加器输入视为已经包含 D2 的 INT32 bias；不重复加 bias。

t16_requantization_source.candidate_algorithm: 非负幅值使用精确整数 round_half_away(magnitude * M / 2**Q)，再对符号和 [-127,127] 饱和；linear 两侧共享 M/Q，leaky 两侧允许独立 M/Q。
t16_requantization_source.channel_payload_readiness: HASH_ONLY; T16 audit computes exact per-channel candidates and hashes them, but its proof JSON stores only the summary and digest
t16_requantization_source.materialization_source: The pinned T16 audit script can deterministically rederive the channel candidates from the frozen manifest; the current proof JSON does not serialize those values
t16_requantization_source.backend_dependency: T23 must expose/re-run that deterministic calculation, materialize each output-channel M/Q, and verify the resulting canonical stream against candidate_parameter_sha256 before RTL integration

operator_parameters.route_group_slice_order: select [group_id*C/groups:(group_id+1)*C/groups] per referenced tensor before requantization and cfg-order concatenation; groups=1 selects [0:C]

global_timeout.source_semantics: timeout_cycles must be nonzero; count rising edges after the accepted start edge; completion at the Nth edge wins over timeout, otherwise abort at that edge
global_timeout.scope: one deadline from accepted start for the whole network; layer transitions never restart it
global_timeout.integration_requirement: future backend must own one G0 deadline and replace/disable the T20/T21 local pilot timers

completion_event.source_handshake: operator_result_valid is a one-cycle pulse sampled on a rising edge while busy; no backpressure; operator_error_code is stable on that edge
completion_event.source_success: error_code=0 means all required feature/head writes completed and the result may be committed as done
completion_event.source_error: known nonzero CSR error codes 1..7 are latched and abort the task; unknown nonzero values map to INTERNAL; error invalidates heads and returns buffer ownership to PS
completion_event.source_timeout_boundary: a valid operator result on the Nth timeout edge wins over timeout; code 0 completes successfully and a nonzero code completes with error
completion_event.producer: single whole-network backend after all required feature/head writes finish or a terminal error occurs

fault_and_cancel.memory_reset_timeout_semantics: hard/soft reset or timeout cancels a pending request without a later memory side effect

golden_readiness.reason: fixed_test_samples.json binds input hashes and ground truth only; it contains no CPU per-layer tensor golden payload/path. D2 limited summaries are not per-layer goldens.
